body_excerpt:
Published: August 26, 2026
Version: 1.0
Revision: 1.0
A malicious actor with access to an adjacent network could exploit a Buffer Overflow vulnerability found in a DHCPv6-enabled EdgeMAX EdgeSwitch to initiate a Remote Code Execution on such device.
Affected Products:
EdgeMAX EdgeSwitch (Version 1.12.1 and earlier)
Mitigation:
Update your EdgeMAX EdgeSwitch to Version 1.12.2 or later.
Impact:
CVSS Severity and Metrics:
Base Score:
9.6 Critical
Vector:
CVSS
:
CVSS:3.1/AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H
CVE
: CVE-2026-77532 (Will Robertson)
Reference Links:
https://uisp.community.ui.com/releases/EdgeMAX-EdgeSwitch-1-12-2/d4a7218e-cd00-4df9-b838-1875ea33f3a6

This update is being rolled out in stages and may not be visible to all users immediately.
